dateNote: Report (issue of Thursday, July 2, 2026) says 'On Tuesday afternoon'; the preceding Tuesday was June 30, 2026, which matches the calendar, and the July 9 meeting approved 'June 30, Special Called Board meeting' minutes.
headline: Special Called School Board Meeting Approves New Employees, iPad Changes, and Facility Projects
summary: At a special called meeting the board approved hires, resignations, the docket of claims, two of three student transfers and a series of agreements, grants and purchases, including 21 iPad carts for 7th and 8th grade iPads. The report states 7th and 8th grade student iPads will remain at school rather than going home nightly.

personnel.note: Hires include 2 substitute teachers, a bus driver, a part-time custodian, coaching assignments, 2 teachers and a high school athletic director (one employee resigned as middle school AD and was hired as high school AD); other = 1 license upgrade.

money.item: One-year subscription renewal bundle (SAM Spectra, SAM Query, Major Clarity, Apple School Manager, Clever, Renlearn, Primero Edge, Canvas GPB, Apptegy, District Data Integrator)
21 iPad carts for 7th and 8th grade iPads (lowest quote)
2026-2027 athletics/activities video streaming/recording rights agreement, one year
SNF 2026 Vulcan Equipment Grant to Child Nutrition Department (accepted)
Four-year subscription to Mosyle OneK12 for the Tech Department

policy.item: 7th and 8th grade student iPads will remain at school instead of going home nightly, with check-out available for educational use; the tech fee for after-school use removed for these grades. High school students continue to take iPads home.
TCSD Child Nutrition Bid Protest Policy for 2026/2027 approved.
